snarer.title: The Snarer
snarer.idea: IT HAS ALREADY SET THE ROOM - it drives you onto its own lines
snarer.feed_line: The lines were here before you.

drillmaster.title: The Drillmaster
drillmaster.idea: IT SUMMONS - it beats the muster and the garrison forms up

scrapwright.title: The Scrapwright
scrapwright.idea: IT ARMOURS ITSELF - every plate knocked off is replaced from the floor

gaoler.title: The Gaoler
gaoler.idea: IT DRAGS - the hook takes one out of the line and reels them in
gaoler.feed_line: A chain is paying out in the dark.

snuffer.title: The Snuffer
snuffer.idea: IT TAKES THE LIGHT - it puts out the lamps one at a time
snuffer.feed_line: The nearest lamp has gone out.

sexton.title: The Sexton
sexton.idea: IT WILL NOT STAY DOWN - it carries its own graves; empty the lit niches
sexton.feed_line: A spade is working somewhere in the dark.

porter.title: The Porter
porter.idea: IT BARS THE WAY - it drops a leaf across the door: no retreat, no help
porter.feed_line: A bar has dropped behind you.

tallyman.title: The Tallyman
tallyman.idea: IT TAKES AND LEAVES - it lifts your gear, wears it and withdraws
tallyman.feed_line: Something is counting what you carry.

cook.title: The Cook
cook.idea: IT KEEPS THE PACK ALIVE - the pot heals the room; spill the pot

sluicekeeper.title: The Sluicekeeper
sluicekeeper.idea: IT RAISES THE WATER - it winds the sluice open a step at a time

sower.title: The Sower
sower.idea: IT PLANTS THE GROUND AGAINST YOU - what it casts stands up as thorn

stoker.title: The Stoker
stoker.idea: IT IS ONLY AS BIG AS THE FIRE - starve the pit and it starves

bellman.title: The Bellman
bellman.idea: IT RINGS FROM WHERE IT IS NOT - the sound comes from the wrong place
bellman.feed_line: A bell, and not where you thought.

boiler.title: The Boiler
boiler.idea: IT POURS AND IT SETS - the floor hardens around your feet

tallyman_chibi.title: The Tallyman (chibi)
tallyman_chibi.idea: IT TAKES AND LEAVES - rebuilt in the game's own register
tallyman_chibi.feed_line: Something is counting what you carry.

cook_chibi.idea: IT KEEPS THE PACK ALIVE - rebuilt in the game's own register

gaoler_chibi.feed_line: A chain is paying out in the dark.

porter_chibi.feed_line: A bar has dropped behind you.

sexton_chibi.feed_line: A spade is working somewhere in the dark.

snuffer_chibi.feed_line: The nearest lamp has gone out.

jointer.title: The Jointer
jointer.idea: IT COMES APART AND BOTH HALVES KEEP WORKING - drive the pin or break it and there are two

quartermaster.title: The Quartermaster
quartermaster.idea: IT ARMS THE ROOM - everything else in here takes a weapon off its sheaf

loader.title: The Loader
loader.idea: IT WEIGHS YOU DOWN - it loads you, and you fight slower until you drop it
loader.feed_line: Something is putting a load on you.

hurdleman.title: The Hurdleman
hurdleman.idea: IT CUTS THE ROOM IN TWO - it plants a hurdle through your line and you fight it two and two
hurdleman.feed_line: A hurdle just went down between you.

tanner.title: The Tanner
tanner.idea: IT WILL NOT TAKE THE SAME BLOW TWICE - what hurts it once it pegs a fresh hide over; change your answer or stop hurting it
tanner.feed_line: It is pegging up a fresh hide.

reeve.title: The Reeve
reeve.idea: IT TAKES THE HAUL - while it stands the floor pays its box and not you; break the box or walk out of here with nothing
reeve.feed_line: It is here for the lord's share.

tapster.title: The Tapster
tapster.idea: IT DRINKS WHAT YOU BROUGHT - every brew raised in this room goes into its tun and not into the hero; run it dry or your line breaks and walks out

pressman.title: The Pressman
pressman.idea: IT PRESSES YOUR FALLEN - a hero that goes down in this room is collared and stood back up on ITS side; get them up, or break the yoke, before the collar shuts
pressman.feed_line: Irons just came off the yoke.

strickler.title: The Strickler
strickler.idea: IT STRIKES YOU LEVEL - while it stands, your best hero is scraped down to the measure of your worst; your strongest is no answer, so lift the lowest or break the beam
strickler.feed_line: Something in here is taking the heap off.

dyer.title: The Dyer
dyer.idea: IT MARKS ONE OF YOU AND HUNTS ONLY THE MARK - it slings the vat, and while the stain is wet it will walk past everyone else to reach the one wearing it; the stain can be passed hero to hero, so the party chooses who carries it and for how long
dyer.feed_line: Something back there just marked one of you.

greener.title: The Greener
greener.idea: IT GREENS YOUR IRON - every blow landed on it leaves the weapon a little more eaten, and a bitten weapon bites less; a hero can stop and scrape it clean, which costs them the time they would have spent swinging, so the party is not choosing how to kill it but how long each of them can afford to keep hitting it

moulder.title: The Moulder
moulder.idea: IT TAKES YOUR SHAPE - it presses one of your heroes into its sand bed and pours, and what stands up out of the box fights with that hero's reach and that hero's swing; the party is not choosing how to kill it but which of them it is allowed to read, so the hero who leads is the hero they will have to fight, and the mould can be broken before the metal sets
moulder.feed_line: It took a copy of one of you.

ratcatcher.title: The Ratcatcher
ratcatcher.idea: IT IS PAID BY THE TAIL - everything else that dies in this room goes into the cage on its hip and it is stronger for every bay it fills, so the party is not choosing how to kill it but whether to clear the room at all; leave the lesser things standing and you fight the whole floor at once, clear them and you hand this one the fight, and the bays already filled can be cut open to give them back
ratcatcher.feed_line: It is paid by the tail.

drover.title: The Drover
drover.idea: IT YOKES ONE OF YOU - it closes a bow of its own yoke on a hero and after that the harm you do it travels the chain: while the collar holds, every blow landed on the Drover is paid half by the one wearing it, so the party is not choosing how hard to hit but whether to hit at all; cut the chain and the yoke comes free to take the next, and the second bow hangs open to tell you it can

paviser.title: The Paviser
paviser.idea: IT KEEPS ITS FACE TO YOU - it carries a pavise on a hinge post and swings it onto whoever is hurting it most, and a blow into the board does nothing at all; so the party cannot win this by standing still and hitting harder - one of you has to get round the post while another holds its attention, and the moment you two swap sides the board swings back
paviser.feed_line: A board came round to face you.

fenman.title: The Fenman
fenman.idea: IT TAKES WHAT STIRS - it is hooded blind and it hunts by disturbance, so it comes for whoever moved last: swing, step, drink, and you are the one it wants. A hero who stands perfectly still is not there as far as it is concerned - and a hero who stands perfectly still is also doing nothing. So the party cannot all fight and cannot all hide; somebody has to stir, and the fight is the argument about who and when

comfitmaker.title: The Comfitmaker
comfitmaker.idea: IT GIVES YOU THE ONLY THING THAT CUTS IT - its shell is sugar-hard and nothing the party carries marks it, but it hands out comfits as it fights and a comfit is the one thing that does. Take one and you can hurt it; the sugar also gums the hand that took it, so that hero swings slower for as long as they hold it. The party cannot hurt it without accepting something from it, and the stand says how many are left
comfitmaker.feed_line: Everything in here is sweet and none of it is kind.

leech.title: The Leech
leech.idea: IT WILL NOT LET A WOUND CLOSE - while it stands nothing in this room mends. Every point of healing the party spends is drawn off into the basin at its side, and the Leech spends what the basin holds on itself, so the level in that basin is the mending you paid for. Tip the basin and it has nothing to mend with and your own healing comes back; leave it standing and your healer is carrying water in a sieve
leech.feed_line: It will have the bad blood out of you, and keep it.

beadle.title: The Beadle
beadle.idea: IT CALLS THE ORDER - while it stands the party does not choose who acts. The Beadle calls, and it calls the same hero again and again while the rest hold their ground and watch; the four brass pegs on the board it holds overhead are the calls it has left and you can count them from the door. Knock the board off its arm and the order comes back to you
beadle.feed_line: It says who speaks, and it is not you.

rammer.title: The Rammer
rammer.idea: IT DROPS ON THE COUNT - it hauls the monkey to the head of the frame, it holds, and it lets go. Whatever is standing on the pile when the monkey falls is finished, and you can HEAR it coming: the haul is slow and the hold is the warning. The answer is not what you do, it is when - stand off the pile for the drop and come back in while it hauls
rammer.feed_line: Something is being driven into the floor.
